discrepancy_resolutions.canonical_value: B2 (A2-E0) N20 K15 is Pareto Champion for Final Retrieval (Final Recall 70.0%, nDCG 0.617, MRR 0.525, EvComp 33.3%). B1 (A1-E1) N20 K15 is Candidate Recall Champion (CandRecall 95.0%).

metric_definitions.Candidate_Recall_N: Fraction of total 20 gold evidence units present in stage-1 candidate pool at depth N
metric_definitions.Final_Recall_K: Fraction of total 20 gold evidence units retained in Top-K output after Cross-Encoder reranking
metric_definitions.Evidence_Precision_K: Useful evidence units in Top-K divided by K
metric_definitions.Primary_Precision_K: Primary evidence units in Top-K divided by K
metric_definitions.MRR: Mean reciprocal rank of first gold evidence unit across all 6 benchmark questions
metric_definitions.nDCG_K: Normalized discounted cumulative gain over gold evidence roles (Primary=3, Supporting=2)
metric_definitions.Evidence_Completeness: Fraction of benchmark questions (0..1) with 100% Final Recall at K
